basis.rule: A committed reader must observe another transaction's non-final modification of the same object; containing an earlier transformed element does not identify that version.
Confirmed same-key aborted-item provenance is a separate direct proof, independent of other list-shape gaps.

basis.rules: G1a uses failed source per observed element; G1b uses only the actual read last element, excluding own writes.

basis.rule: Non-final modifications are indexed per object and transaction.

decisions.G1a: Retain a specific witness when the read actually contains a matching immutable ID and business value of the same key, observed earlier, from a confirmed aborted external writer. A separate shape gap must not erase this independent proof. Wrong-key/value source observations do not prove it.
decisions.G1b: For source-valid complete list values, inspect only the actual final item. An external confirmed writer with a later same-key append proves an intermediate read; final external and own last appends do not.
decisions.externalProducerPrefix: A read must preserve the relative sequence and prefix of each external producer's same-key append actions. Non-prefix [b] and reordered [b,a] receive explicit validity gaps; they cannot establish complete graph, G1b or INT claims. G1b remains unknown there, even if a malformed value happens to end in a non-final ID.
decisions.otherEvidence: A reliable G1a or an independent valid graph witness can still refute a model while other checks are unknown. Do not change formal model IDs or old assertions.
decisions.scope: Savepoint/reverted-list source semantics remain outside this direct G1b proof; no new source order inference or mixed-model support.
